facts.fact: Criminal investigation police arrested journalist Gurashi Awad in River Nile State on a complaint by a General Intelligence Service lieutenant colonel under the 2007 Cybercrime Act, the Sudanese Journalists Syndicate said; he was held at Berber police station.
The syndicate cites the 2007 Cybercrime Act as the basis of a live arrest and calls for its repeal; date is the Thursday before the Friday statement in the 2026-08-17 article.
